title: ArcCivs 0.1.93: mine exit, nearby work and thinning existing joined trees
assumptions: Before quantities are source .92. Live .92 has successful forester cycles with +3 abstract WOOD and repeated pauses; do not model the entire forester or city as earning zero. Miner cycle216 has a confirmed stalled return leg; only affected future miner completions are modeled as zero before.

Low/base/high are hypothetical 0.25/1/4 active hours and 1/4/6 villages. Before forester6/24/72 versus after12/48/144 completed L1 trees is a sensitivity, not measured throughput or a new target rate. Miner restoration6/24/72 completions is separate. Values are not simultaneous physical-town income.

Gross FORESTER4/8/12 WOOD and QUARRY3/6/9 STONE by level remain unchanged. Normal replant consumes one abstract WOOD per plot. Existing joined trees may be thinned: no replacement sapling and no seed debit. In the after sensitivity2/6/12 of the12/48/144 tree completions thin existing crowded roots; the other10/42/132 replant normally. No bonus grant exists. Actual thinning is bounded by observed crowded trees, not a recurring daily entitlement; new planting reserves both crowns.

A full standalone planting later consumes the existing1 WOOD per plot. Thus relocating a thinned tree to an adequate new plot restores the original net3WOOD per harvest; the selected sensitivity excludes that later planting and conservatively counts the immediate maximum retained seed stock. Player-founded towns similarly retain their1 or4 physical saplings when no replant occurs; no sapling is minted.

Previously accepted forestry jobs and historical receipts retain their original replant and debit. The new optional thinning flag defaults false for old serialized jobs. Partial tree batches never issue a final reward. Skipped or changed decorative blocks do not grant stock or items.

One completed forestry/economic cycle grants1 profession XP. Native mine/field scenery, route progress, hotload and plan-board forecasts grant none. XP before6/24/72 and after18/72/216 includes two independent worker streams.

QUARRY observed work remains60000ms (120000ms at hunger<=6), followed by real depot travel and its normal receipt. Food, construction prices, storage caps, work budgets and reward quantities remain unchanged. Board v2 moves one barrel within the same free-standing blueprint; footprint, slots and12WOOD+8STONE price stay unchanged.

Abstract WOOD, STONE, resident profession XP, player inventory, Vault and tokens remain separate. Hotload, forecasts and road occupancy removal do not directly mint anything. A road repair retains its existing1STONE charge and3second work. Faster access can restore realized production/resale; current physical output and sales are unmeasured, not assumed zero.

Existing EconomyShopGUI SELL remains current and the SELL-off/contracts transition remains future. No shop quote, exchange rate, contract or monetization changes. Thinning reduces excess tree density and later replacement restores the existing seed cost; no new economic cap is added.
